# Matterport

Capture, share, and collaborate the built world in immersive 3D

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/matterport/.

## Actions

- **Get Model by ID** (read-only): Retrieve detailed information about a single Matterport 3D model by its ID.
- **Query Matterport Models** (read-only): Retrieve a page of Matterport models with optional search and filtering.
- **Update Model State**: Change a Matterport model between active and inactive (archived) states.
- **Delete Matterport Model**: Permanently delete a Matterport model.
- **Get Model Event Webhook Callbacks** (read-only): Retrieve a list of registered webhook callback configurations for model events.
- **List Room Classifications** (read-only): List all room classifications defined for Matterport room classification models.
